acquisition_method: Data-dependent acquisition mode was used to trigger precursor isolation and sequencing.
alkylation_concentration: Five microliters of IAA solution (30 mM in 50 mM ABC) was dispensed to alkylate sulfhydryl groups by incubating the vials in the dark for 30 min at room temperature.
alkylation_reagent: Five microliters of IAA solution (30 mM in 50 mM ABC) was dispensed to alkylate sulfhydryl groups by incubating the vials in the dark for 30 min at room temperature.
cleavage_agent: Five microliters of Lys-C (0.25 ng in 50 mM ABC) was added and incubated at 37 °C for 4 h. Five microliters of trypsin (0.25 ng in 50 mM ABC) was added and incubated overnight at 37 °C.
collision_energy: Precursor ions with charges of +2 to +7 were isolated with an m/z window of 2 and fragmented by high energy dissociation with a collision energy of 28%.
fragmentation_method: inferred: fragmented by high energy dissociation with a collision energy of 28%.
instrument: An Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid MS (ThermoFisher) was employed for all data collection.
ionization_type: Electrospray voltage of 1.9 kV was applied at the source.
labeling: LFQ calculations were performed separately in each parameter group containing similar cell loading.
mass_analyzer: inferred: An Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid MS (ThermoFisher) was employed for all data collection.
ptm: N-terminal protein acetylation, methionine oxidation, Carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues
N-terminal protein acetylation and methionine oxidation were selected as variable modifications. Carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues was set as a fixed modification.
reduction_concentration: For sample preparation of cultured cells, 50-nL RapiGest (0.2%) solution with 10 mM DTT in 50 mM ABC was added to the nanodroplets that had been preloaded with cells.
reduction_reagent: For sample preparation of cultured cells, 50-nL RapiGest (0.2%) solution with 10 mM DTT in 50 mM ABC was added to the nanodroplets that had been preloaded with cells.
